messages:
Emma Chen: FYI — AcmeInfra sent a new pricing feed for Q2 that includes an 'auction-style' spot window + reserved blending options. I skimmed it, looks like a new commitment tier (commit_pct) baked into marketplace listings.
Marketplace Bot: New file uploaded by Emma Chen: /marketplace/acme/pricing_q2_2027.csv :paperclip: (sha256: e3b0c442)
Raj Patel: Quick clarification: do reserved commitments apply to marketplace SKUs directly or only via partner-managed reserved contracts? Asking because our cost model treats marketplace listings as pure spot today.
Sofia Gomez: They explicitly call out "marketplace-reserved" in the CSV. Notes: marketplace fee ~12% on top, provisioning lead time 30d for reserved SKU activation. So it's not only direct contracts.
Alex Rivera: Interesting — so a customer could buy reserved capacity through marketplace and get a lower spot+fee blended rate? How does the auction window work?
Emma Chen: Per vendor doc: auction window = hourly bidding period where spot price can drop below base spot if utilization low. They expose three price bands: peak, mid, tail. They also allow commit_pct (0-1) which reduces your exposure to auction windows.
Raj Patel: For modeling I need a deterministic blending formula. Proposal (simple):
  blended_rate = reserved_rate * commit_pct + effective_spot_rate * (1 - commit_pct) + marketplace_fee
where effective_spot_rate = spot_rate * auction_discount_factor
Emma Chen: That matches my notes. Example numbers from CSV snippet:
  sku,region,reserved_rate,spot_rate,auction_discount_factor,commit_min_hours
  acme-a100-80g,us-west,2.40,0.65,0.6,720
  acme-a100-80g,eu-central,2.55,0.72,0.5,720
Sofia Gomez: Important: reserved_rate above is already net of vendor rebate but BEFORE marketplace fee. So marketplace_fee should be applied after blending.
Alex Rivera: We should also model latency/placement constraints — marketplace reserved may be region-limited (they mention "zone affinity"). That affects effective utilization and therefore spot discount realized.
Raj Patel: Actionable ask for modeling: can someone confirm these fields for all SKUs in the CSV? I need: reserved_rate, spot_rate (median), auction_discount_factor (0-1), commit_min_hours, marketplace_fee_pct, region_exclusions.
Emma Chen: I'll ask Acme for a machine-readable JSON with those fields and a sample reservation contract id. I'll push for a flag indicating whether marketplace-reserved supports immediate fallback to our direct pool (important for SLOs).
Marketplace Bot: @Emma Chen requested file: acme_pricing_machine_readable_2027.json — status: pending vendor upload
Sofia Gomez: Also note their broker contract has a 6% early-termination surcharge for commitments >90d. Model needs a churn-adjusted effective hourly rate when commitments are broken.
Raj Patel: Good call. For the Q2 sensitivity run I'll run three scenarios: conservative (commit_pct=0.2), mid (0.5), aggressive (0.8). Also run with marketplace_fee at 12% and 0 (partner promo) to see delta.
Alex Rivera: For partnership collateral: we should agree on messaging that marketplace-reserved gives predictability but "not equivalent to dedicated direct commitments" — ops implications.
Emma Chen: Agree. I'll coordinate with legal/partnerships on a short FAQ for customers and split the pricing examples for marketplace vs dedicated.
Raj Patel: I'll mock up a simple notebook and push to /analytics/marketplace/blend_sims.ipynb by EOD. @Sofia can you review assumptions?
Sofia Gomez: Yep — will review. If vendor provides churn rates and real auction histograms that will improve the simulation.
Alex Rivera: :thumbsup: Let's sync Friday for go/no-go on listing support in the marketplace catalog.
Emma Chen: Thanks everyone — looping in partnerships PM after we get the JSON. :raised_hands:
